answer: Sixteen catalog-reconstructed source classes are routed to live backends on this host. Public HTTPS APIs (GitHub, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Stack Exchange, Wikipedia, IETF, Wayback available-API, YouTube oEmbed, Google Patents, Lobsters, Python docs/blog) are UP without vendor keys. Search-hub Exa/Tavily/Firecrawl/SearxNG are AUTH_ABSENT. public-tor is OWNER_GATED (no owner flag, SOCKS 9050 closed). Detector control: example.com UP and res-0168-deliberately-wrong.invalid DOWN. A 16-class fan-out would ABORT before 50 agents launch. GitHub unauthenticated core remaining=5000/5000.

preflight_contract.must_run_before: any fan-out of N>=2 research agents
steps: Run detector control (known-good UP, known-bad DOWN). If both UP, abort: detector is dead.
For each planned source class, probe primary then fallbacks.
Read advertised remaining quota (GitHub X-RateLimit-Remaining / JSON core.remaining; Stack Exchange quota_remaining).
Classify AUTH_ABSENT / AUTH_FAIL / QUOTA / DOWN / OWNER_GATED / UP.
If any planned class is UNSERVABLE, OWNER_GATED, QUOTA, or discovery-blocked, abort and do not launch 50 agents.
